tagline.en: Swiss eSIM service with fixed and unlimited plans for 200+ destinations
tagline.zh: 瑞士 eSIM 服务，200+ 目的地定额与不限量套餐

description.en: Yesim is a Switzerland-based eSIM service offering fixed and unlimited data plans for 200+ destinations, with an app-first flow, VPN feature on some tiers and multi-network access.
description.zh: Yesim 是总部在瑞士的 eSIM 服务，为 200+ 目的地提供定额与不限量套餐，以 App 为主流程，部分档位带 VPN 功能，多网接入。

zh: 定额与不限量两种套餐

details.en:
Yesim is a Switzerland-based eSIM service offering both fixed and unlimited catalogs for 200+ destinations, with 4M+ users claimed. Its differentiators versus peers: a European regulatory footing, dual plan catalogs, and balance top-ups on many plans instead of issuing a new eSIM.

Prices (verified on yesim.app/country/japan, 2026-11-10): unlimited from $4.20 for 1 day, with the daily rate stepping down as days increase; the fixed catalog was captured the same session: 1GB/30d $4.44, 5GB $10.56, 10GB $19.20, 20GB $29.76, 30GB $39.60 (Japan). Data-only, with balance top-up supported.

Notes: the unlimited daily rate is mid-pack rather than the cheapest; promo figures quoted by some third-party directories could not be re-verified on the official site; the experience is app-first; and searches can confuse it with the same-named Turkish textile company Yesim (Yesim with cedilla) - the correct domain is yesim.app.
details.zh:
Yesim 是总部在瑞士的 eSIM 服务商，同时提供定额与不限量两类套餐，覆盖 200+ 目的地，官方口径 4M+ 用户。相对同行，它的差异化是"欧洲监管背景 + 双套餐目录 + 多数套餐可充值续用（不必换新 eSIM）"。

价格（2026-11-10 日本页实核）：不限量 1 天 $4.20 起，天数越多日均价越低（页面按天数阶梯展示）；定额目录已同场核验：日本 1GB/30 天 $4.44、5GB $10.56、10GB $19.20、20GB $29.76、30GB $39.60。纯数据，支持余额充值。

注意点：不限量日均价属中等水平，不是最便宜的一档；部分第三方目录引用的促销价未能在官网复验；体验以 App 为主；搜索时易与土耳其同名纺织公司 Yeşim 混淆，认准 yesim.app。

补充：Yesim 支持余额充值与多套餐共存于同一账户，行程连续多国的用户可在 App 内切换目的地套餐而无需重复安装 eSIM；具体可用性以 App 内实际显示为准。
